fields.name: blobName
fields.doc: Canonical blob path the agent MUST persist as SessionSummary.DiagnosticsBlobName after a successful upload. Encodes the destination-specific path layout so the download path can find the blob later without having to reconstruct it: CustomerSas: equal to the request filename (e.g. AgentDiagnostics-...zip).Hosted: tenant-prefixed (e.g. {tenantId}/AgentDiagnostics-...zip). Null for older backends that predate this field — the agent then falls back to the request filename for back-compat.

fields.name: destination
fields.doc: Which destination minted the SAS in UploadUrl: "CustomerSas" or "Hosted". Surfaced so the agent's ingest path can attach it to the next telemetry batch (the download path needs the per-session destination, NOT the current tenant setting — those can diverge if the admin switches modes after some sessions have already uploaded).

GetGlobalAdminsResponse.doc: Response of GET auth/global-admins: every Global Admin/Reader row.

GetGlobalMcpUsageDailyResponse.doc: Global daily MCP/API usage summaries envelope (GetGlobalMcpUsageDaily). The MCP server paginates over the summaries key — its name is wire-critical.

fields.name: tenantId
fields.doc: Echo of the request filter; absent when the caller passed no tenantId.

GetGlobalMcpUsageResponse.doc: Global per-tenant MCP/API usage envelope (GetGlobalMcpUsage). The MCP server paginates over the records key — its name is wire-critical.

fields.name: tenantId
fields.doc: Echo of the request filter; absent when the caller passed no tenantId.

GetGraphPermissionsStatusResponse.doc: Response of GET tenants/{tenantId}/graph-permissions/status: the client id of the app homed for the tenant, the transient flag, the granted Graph app roles and the per-feature verdict matrix.

fields.name: clientId
fields.doc: ClientId of the app registration that acts for this tenant (empty string when unresolved, never null).

fields.name: isTransient
fields.doc: True when the snapshot is not authoritative (token-acquire timeout / transient failure) — the UI renders "try again".

GetIgnoredSoftwareResponse.doc: Response of GET vulnerability/ignored-software: the full ignore list.

GetLatestVersionsResponse.doc: Response of GET config/latest-versions: the latest published agent + bootstrap script versions (null slots when the version blob could not be fetched).

fields.name: source
fields.doc: "cache" or "blob".

GetMcpOrganizationUsageResponse.doc: Organization-wide MCP usage by user for the caller's OWN tenant (GetMcpOrganizationUsage): every account whose requests were charged to this tenant's organization budget — its own members and any delegated (MSP) administrators reading the tenant. Built from the tenant's organization counters.

fields.name: dateFrom
fields.doc: Effective range start (yyyyMMdd).

fields.name: dateTo
fields.doc: Effective range end (yyyyMMdd, inclusive).

GetMcpUserUsageResponse.doc: Per-user MCP/API usage envelope (GetMcpUserUsage). Non-global callers only receive the records attributed to their own tenant; a foreign oid and an unknown oid are indistinguishable (both 200 with empty records). The MCP server paginates over the records key — its name is wire-critical.

GetMcpUsersResponse.doc: Response of GET global/mcp-users: the effective MCP access policy name plus every whitelist row.

GetMyMcpUsageResponse.doc: Self-service MCP/API usage envelope (GetMyMcpUsage): the caller's own usage records plus resolved plan and quota state. The MCP server paginates over the records key — its name is wire-critical.

fields.name: upn
fields.doc: Absent when the token carries no UPN claim.

fields.name: usagePlan
fields.doc: Per-user plan override from the caller's own whitelist row; absent without one.

fields.name: effectivePlan
fields.doc: Resolved effective plan (per-user override → tenant edition).

GetPlatformStatsResponse.doc: Landing-page platform stats envelope (GetPlatformStats, unauthenticated). When no stats row has been computed yet, the zero shape is served: all counters 0 with TotalSignedUpTenants and LastUpdated absent.

fields.name: totalSignedUpTenants
fields.doc: Absent on the not-yet-computed zero shape.

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.doc: Always absent today: the computed shape never sets it, the zero shape sets null.

GetPreviewNotificationEmailResponse.doc: Response of GET preview/notification-email/{tenantId}. Empty string when no address is stored (never null — the site coalesces).

GetPreviewWhitelistResponse.doc: Response of GET preview/whitelist: every approved tenant (Global Admin only).

GetRuleHitSessionsResponse.doc: Session ids where a rule produced a result within the window (GetRuleHitSessions) — powers the dashboard's ?ruleId= deep link.

fields.name: truncated
fields.doc: True when the result hit the hit-set cap (2000) — the list is a lower bound.

GetRuleResultsResponse.doc: Response of GET sessions/{sessionId}/analysis: persisted rule results plus severity counts over the still-open (unresolved) findings.

fields.name: success
fields.doc: False when any rule result failed to persist during an on-demand reanalyze.

fields.name: results
fields.doc: All persisted results, including resolved findings (kept for audit).

fields.name: totalIssues
fields.doc: Count of open (unresolved) findings only.

fields.name: persistFailureRuleIds
fields.doc: Rule ids that failed to persist during the reanalyze — the key is omitted entirely when there were no failures (the happy-path contract stays unchanged).

GetScriptDisplayNamesResponse.doc: Response of POST tenants/{tenantId}/scripts/display-names: resolved Intune script display names keyed by the canonical ref string. Always 200, possibly partial — unresolved refs stay in the dictionary with a null VALUE (dictionary values are NOT subject to WhenWritingNull, so the key is emitted with an explicit JSON null).

fields.name: refs
fields.doc: Display name per canonical script ref ("Platform:{id}" / "Remediation:{id}"). IMPORTANT: dictionary KEYS do not run through the camelCase PropertyNamingPolicy (ApiJsonOptions sets no DictionaryKeyPolicy) — the ref strings are serialized verbatim, including the PascalCase type prefix. Pinned by GraphWireParityTests.

fields.name: malformed
fields.doc: Ref tokens from the request that failed to parse, or null when there were none — the key is omitted when null (the empty-body and empty-refs early-exit sites never wrote this key at all; they leave it null).

GetSessionAnnotationsResponse.doc: Response of GET sessions/{sessionId}/annotations: the annotation lanes visible to the caller plus the server-computed list of lanes the caller may write.

fields.name: writableLanes
fields.doc: Lanes the caller is allowed to write — the web renders lanes writable exactly when this list says so.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: Always "summary" — full/download modes bypass the JSON envelope.

fields.name: inFlightHint
fields.doc: Operator hint when a cascade is already in flight; absent otherwise.

fields.name: sampleKeys
fields.doc: Up to five sample row keys per table/step.

fields.name: estimatedSnapshotBytes
fields.doc: -1 when the size estimation itself failed.

GetSessionDeletionManifestResponse.doc: Stored cascade-delete snapshot summary envelope (GetSessionDeletionManifest, mode=summary).

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: Always "summary" — full/download modes bypass the JSON envelope.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Always "stored" (vs the delete-preview's freshly built manifest).

fields.name: sampleKeys
fields.doc: Up to five sample row keys per table/step.

fields.name: progress
fields.doc: Absent while no progress blob exists yet (Preparing phase) or it could not be read.

GetSessionDeletionsListResponse.doc: Cross-tenant listing of sessions in a cascade-deletion state (GetSessionDeletionsList).

fields.name: strandedSinceMinutes
fields.doc: Echo of the request filter; absent unless the caller passed it.

GetSessionEventsResponse.doc: Session events envelope (GetSessionEvents, paginated and unpaginated paths). Events carries full EnrollmentEvent items, or dictionary projections of them when the caller passed a fields= subset.

fields.name: nextLink
fields.doc: Absent on the unpaginated path and when there is no further page.

GetSessionTimeAttributionResponse.doc: Per-session time-attribution envelope (GetSessionTimeAttribution). A missing breakdown is a NORMAL outcome (pre-feature session, non-terminal, Incomplete — no wall clock).

fields.name: breakdown
fields.doc: Absent when no breakdown row exists — the UI simply omits the lane.

GetTenantConfigFieldsSchemaResponse.doc: Response of GET config/fields-schema: the machine-readable tenant-config field schema for the MCP write surface.

fields.name: sessionFilter
fields.doc: Echo of the optional sessionId filter; absent when not passed.

GetTenantsWithDeletionManifestsResponse.doc: Tenants that have at least one deletion-manifest blob (GetTenantsWithDeletionManifests).

GetUnmatchedSoftwareResponse.doc: Response of GET vulnerability/unmatched-software: one page of the aggregated report.

fields.name: total
fields.doc: Total distinct unmatched titles before paging.

GetVulnerabilityReportResponse.doc: Response of GET sessions/{sessionId}/vulnerability-report on the rescan paths and the no-stored-report path. (A stored-report hit streams the raw report JSON directly and bypasses this DTO.)

fields.name: report
fields.doc: The freshly generated report, or null (key omitted) when there is none.

fields.name: rescanned
fields.doc: True on the ?rescan=true paths; null (key omitted) on the plain read.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: Human-readable outcome note on the no-inventory / no-findings rescan paths; null (key omitted) otherwise.

GetVulnerabilitySyncStatusResponse.doc: Response of GET vulnerability/sync-status: live KEV/MSRC/NVD/EPSS cache sizes, the persisted last-sync timestamps, and the in-memory last-run stats of this instance.

fields.name: kevLastSyncUtc
fields.doc: Preformatted ISO-8601 timestamp from AdminConfiguration, or null (key omitted) when never synced.

fields.name: nvdLastRun
fields.doc: Last run on THIS instance (in-memory; null / key omitted after a cold start).

fields.name: epssLastRun
fields.doc: Last run on THIS instance (in-memory; null / key omitted after a cold start).

GlobalAdminRow.doc: One Global Admin/Reader row on the wire. Deliberately NOT the storage entity: the ITableEntity keys (partitionKey/rowKey/eTag/timestamp) that the pre-2026-08-31 wire carried are storage internals and were dropped from the contract (no consumer read them).

fields.name: upn
fields.doc: User Principal Name (lowercase).

fields.name: role
fields.doc: "GlobalAdmin" or "GlobalReader" (legacy empty rows are normalized to GlobalAdmin).

GlobalAverages.doc: Global average benchmarks for geographic comparison.

fields.name: avgApiLatencyMs
fields.doc: Global request-weighted average agent→backend API latency (ms); 0 = no data yet

fields.name: medianApiLatencyMs
fields.doc: Global median of per-session average API latency (ms), robust against outliers; 0 = no data yet

fields.name: avgDoPercentPeerCaching
fields.doc: Global weighted average peer caching percentage

fields.name: totalDoBytesFromPeers
fields.doc: Total peer bytes across all locations with DO data

fields.name: totalDoBytesFromHttp
fields.doc: Total HTTP bytes across all locations with DO data

GlobalNotificationDto.doc: One in-app notification (global pool or tenant-scoped; both endpoints share this DTO). A null Href key is omitted (WhenWritingNull).

fields.name: tenantId
fields.doc: The MANAGED (target) tenant the UPN may read.

fields.name: homeTenantId
fields.doc: The grantee's HOME Entra tenant id (optional override) — resolved from sign-in history / UPN domain when omitted.

fields.name: objectId
fields.doc: The grantee's Entra object id (optional) — taken from sign-in history, else pinned on their first sign-in.

GraphFeatureStatusItem.doc: One feature row of the graph-permissions status matrix: the feature identifier, the granted verdict (null while the snapshot is transient) and the Graph application permissions the feature requires.

fields.name: granted
fields.doc: Granted verdict, or null when the snapshot is transient (verdict unknown) — the key is omitted when null.

HardwareRejectedItem.doc: One manufacturer+model bucket in the GetHardwareRejected aggregation. All values are self-reported by devices through the unauthenticated distress channel — UNVERIFIED.

fields.name: sampleSerialNumbers
fields.doc: Up to five distinct serial numbers from the bucket.

HardwareRejectedResponse.doc: Success body of GET audit/hardware-rejected: hardware-whitelist rejections aggregated by manufacturer+model over the distress-report retention window.

fields.name: totalRawReports
fields.doc: Count of raw HardwareNotAllowed distress reports before aggregation.

HealthCheck.doc: One health check result inside GET health/detailed / health/mcp. Details is a heterogeneous per-check bag by design (endpoint URLs only for Global Admins); a null Details key is omitted (WhenWritingNull).

HealthCheckResponse.doc: Response of GET health: liveness probe plus the backend build identity.

IdentityBindingListResponse.doc: Response of GET global/identity-bindings: every admin identity binding.

IdentityBindingRequest.doc: Body of PUT global/identity-bindings/{upn}: the home tenant (GUID, required) and object id (GUID, optional) a person is pinned to.

IdentityBindingResponse.doc: Response of PUT global/identity-bindings/{upn}: the created/replaced binding.

IgnoredSoftwareItem.doc: One entry of the persistent software ignore list.

fields.name: ignoredAt
fields.doc: Preformatted ISO-8601 timestamp; empty when the row carries none.

ImeLogPattern.doc: Defines a regex pattern for IME log parsing. Delivered from backend via agent config endpoint. Allows updating patterns without agent rebuild when Microsoft changes IME log formats.

fields.name: patternId
fields.doc: Unique pattern identifier (e.g., "IME-ESP-PHASE")

fields.name: category
fields.doc: Pattern category controlling when the pattern is active: - "always": Always active regardless of ESP phase - "currentPhase": Only active during the current ESP phase - "otherPhases": Only active during non-current ESP phases (for history/completed apps)

fields.name: pattern
fields.doc: Regex pattern string to match against IME log message content. Supports named capture groups (e.g., (?<id>...)) which are passed to the action handler. Uses {GUID} as placeholder for the standard GUID capture pattern.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: Action to perform when the pattern matches: - "setCurrentApp": Set the current app being processed (uses 'id' capture group) - "updateStateInstalled": Mark app as installed - "updateStateDownloading": Mark app as downloading (uses 'bytes'/'ofbytes' for progress) - "updateStateInstalling": Mark app as installing - "updateStateSkipped": Mark app as skipped/not applicable - "updateStateError": Mark app as errored - "updateStatePostponed": Mark app as postponed (e.g., timeout) - "espPhaseDetected": ESP phase transition detected (uses 'espPhase' capture group) - "imeStarted": IME agent started - "policiesDiscovered": App policies JSON discovered (uses 'policies' capture group) - "ignoreCompletedApp": Add current app to ignore list (already completed in prior phase) - "imeAgentVersion": IME version detected (uses 'agentVersion' capture group) - "espTrackStatus": ESP tracked install status update (uses 'from'/'to'/'id' capture groups) - "updateName": Update app name (uses 'id'/'name' capture groups) - "updateWin32AppState": Update from Win32 app state (uses 'id'/'state' capture groups) - "cancelStuckAndSetCurrent": Cancel stuck app and set new current (uses 'id' capture group)

fields.name: parameters
fields.doc: Optional extra parameters for the action handler. Examples: - { "phase": "AccountSetup" } for espPhaseDetected to force a specific phase - { "useCurrentApp": "true" } to use CurrentPackageId instead of captured 'id' - { "checkTo": "true" } to check the 'to' capture group value before applying state

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Whether this pattern is enabled. Allows disabling patterns without removing them.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Human-readable description of what this pattern detects and why. Not used by the agent — purely for documentation and UI display.

fields.name: isBuiltIn
fields.doc: Whether this is a built-in pattern (shipped with the system). Built-in patterns cannot be deleted, only disabled.

fields.name: baselineRate
fields.doc: Hit rate on the baseline version; null without a baseline.

fields.name: expected
fields.doc: True when the baseline rate is at or above the expected threshold.

fields.name: sessions
fields.doc: Sessions that delivered a histogram on this version (not the ImeVersionHistory session count).

fields.name: fleetSessions
fields.doc: Total sessions per ImeVersionHistory (includes sessions without a terminal run).

ImeVersionHistoryEntry.doc: A tracked IME version sighting. Permanent archive that survives data retention.

fields.name: corroboratedAt
fields.doc: UTC time of the first sighting from a tenant OTHER than FirstSeenTenantId; null while only the first-seen tenant has reported the version. A version is shown to ordinary tenant members only once it is corroborated this way or its installer was archived with a matching ProductVersion — a single tenant's devices (the least trusted principal) cannot publish a version to every other tenant on their own.

fields.name: msiArchiveStatus
fields.doc: Outcome of the automatic installer archiving (ImeMsiArchiver): Archived, Queued (re-queued by a later sighting) or a Failed:* status; null for versions sighted before the feature existed or while the first archive job is still queued. Like the FirstSeen* identifiers, the archive fields are only serialized for Global Admin callers.

fields.name: msiArchiveUpdatedAt
fields.doc: UTC time of the last archive-status change (queue/attempt); drives the re-queue backoff.

fields.name: msiArchiveBlobPath
fields.doc: Blob path inside the ime-archive container, e.g. 1.104.102.0/IntuneWindowsAgent.msi.

fields.name: msiSha256
fields.doc: SHA-256 of the archived installer (hex, lowercase).

fields.name: msiBytes
fields.doc: Size of the archived installer in bytes.

fields.name: msiSourceUrl
fields.doc: The URL the installer was downloaded from (CSP-reported or one of the distribution hosts).

ImeVersionHistoryLeanEntry.doc: Redacted IME version row served to non-global callers of GET metrics/ime-versions: the platform-wide rollout facts without the first-seen tenant/session identifiers or the archive columns (see GetImeVersionHistoryFunction.BuildResponsePayload).

IngestEventsResponse.doc: 2xx body of agent/telemetry. The agent reads only the control signals (DeviceBlocked, UnblockAt, DeviceKillSignal, AdminAction, Actions) from it; a 200 with DeviceBlocked = true deliberately carries Success = false.

fields.name: rateLimitExceeded
fields.doc: Whether the request was rejected due to rate limiting

fields.name: rateLimitInfo
fields.doc: Rate limit details (only populated if RateLimitExceeded is true)

fields.name: deviceBlocked
fields.doc: Whether the device has been temporarily blocked by an admin

fields.name: unblockAt
fields.doc: When the block expires (only populated if DeviceBlocked is true)

fields.name: deviceKillSignal
fields.doc: Whether the device has been issued a remote kill signal (graceful self-destruct). The agent should execute its self-destruct routine and exit.

fields.name: adminAction
fields.doc: Non-null when an admin has externally changed the session status. Values: "Succeeded", "Failed". Agent should treat as terminal signal and run cleanup.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc: Generic server→agent action channel. Null/empty when no actions are pending. Delivered at-least-once; agents must handle actions idempotently. Unknown action types should be logged and skipped (forward-compatibility).

IsGlobalAdminResponse.doc: Response of GET auth/is-global-admin: whether the caller holds the Global Admin platform role, echoing the caller's UPN.

fields.name: upn
fields.doc: Caller's UPN from the token, or null when the token carries no UPN claim — the key is omitted when null.

KqlColumn.doc: A Kusto column header: name plus the store's scalar type name (string, long, real, datetime, dynamic, bool).

KqlTable.doc: One Kusto result table: column headers once, then rows as positional cell arrays.

fields.name: rows
fields.doc: Positional cells, one list per row, aligned with Columns. Cells are forwarded as the JSON the store produced (numbers stay numbers, customDimensions stays the JSON string App Insights emits, nulls stay null) — JsonElement is the honest "unknown" in the wire manifest.

ListBackupsResponse.doc: Response of GET global/backups: every backupId in the critical-table-backups container, newest first. Serialized with SerializerOptions (the backup surface's own options), not the ApiJsonOptions pipeline.

ListRawTablesResponse.doc: Success body of GET /api/global/raw/tables (ListRawTables): the queryable table names.

ListTenantConfigBackupsResponse.doc: Response of GET config/{tenantId}/backups: the tenant's pre-write config snapshots, newest first.

LocationMetrics.doc: Performance metrics for a single geographic location.

fields.name: avgAppCount
fields.doc: Average number of apps installed per session at this location

fields.name: minutesPerApp
fields.doc: Average minutes per app (AvgDurationMinutes / AvgAppCount)

fields.name: appLoadScore
fields.doc: Normalized score: 100 = global median, lower is better

fields.name: avgThroughputBytesPerSec
fields.doc: Average download throughput in bytes/sec at this location

fields.name: durationVsGlobalPct
fields.doc: Percentage difference from global avg duration (negative = faster)

fields.name: throughputVsGlobalPct
fields.doc: Percentage difference from global avg throughput (positive = faster)

fields.name: avgApiLatencyMs
fields.doc: Average agent→backend HTTP round-trip (ms) at this location, weighted per session by its request count. 0 when no session here carries latency data (pre-feature agents). A single corrupt session average (e.g. a request spanning a sleep/hibernate) can dominate this figure — use MedianApiLatencyMs as the display statistic.

fields.name: medianApiLatencyMs
fields.doc: Median of the per-session average agent→backend round-trips (ms) at this location — robust against outlier sessions. 0 when no session here carries latency data.

fields.name: apiLatencySessionCount
fields.doc: Sessions at this location that carry API-latency data

fields.name: apiLatencyVsGlobalPct
fields.doc: Percentage difference from global median API latency (positive = slower/farther)

fields.name: outlierDirection
fields.doc: "fast", "slow", or null

fields.name: doSessionCount
fields.doc: Sessions at this location that have DO telemetry data

fields.name: avgDoPercentPeerCaching
fields.doc: Weighted percentage of bytes from peers (0-100), computed from total peer/total DO bytes

fields.name: totalDoBytesFromPeers
fields.doc: Total bytes downloaded from all peer sources

fields.name: totalDoBytesFromHttp
fields.doc: Total bytes downloaded from HTTP/CDN

fields.name: totalDoBytesFromLanPeers
fields.doc: Bytes from LAN peers

fields.name: totalDoBytesFromGroupPeers
fields.doc: Bytes from group peers

fields.name: totalDoBytesFromInternetPeers
fields.doc: Bytes from internet peers

fields.name: totalDoBytesFromLinkLocalPeers
fields.doc: Bytes from link-local peers (same subnet)

fields.name: totalDoBytesFromCacheServer
fields.doc: Bytes served from a Microsoft Connected Cache (MCC) — separate from BytesFromPeers

LocationSessionLeanRow.doc: Lean projection of LocationSessionRow used as the default drilldown row. Fields chosen to support the typical MCP triage flow (which session, when, where, how big a deal, was DO active). Built by GetGeographicLocationSessionsFunction.ToLeanRow.

fields.name: completedAt
fields.doc: Absent while the session has not completed.

fields.name: durationSeconds
fields.doc: Absent while the session carries no authoritative duration.

fields.name: doPercentPeerCaching
fields.doc: Weighted peer-caching percentage for this session (0-100, one decimal).

LocationSessionRow.doc: Session row returned by the geographic drilldown endpoint. Extends SessionSummary with per-session Delivery Optimization aggregates so the user can troubleshoot DO usage without leaving the drilldown view.

fields.name: hasDoTelemetry
fields.doc: True if any app in this session has DO telemetry (DoDownloadMode >= 0).

fields.name: doAppCount
fields.doc: Number of apps in this session that have DO telemetry.

fields.name: totalAppCount
fields.doc: Total number of app install summaries recorded for this session.

fields.name: doPercentPeerCaching
fields.doc: Weighted peer-caching percentage for this session (0-100).

LogPatternLineResult.doc: Per-line outcome row of one pattern test.

fields.name: outcome
fields.doc: matched | no_match | parse_failed | regex_timeout

fields.name: groups
fields.doc: The named/numbered capture groups exactly as they would land in the emitted event's data (group "0" excluded, unsuccessful groups omitted).

fields.name: component
fields.doc: cmtrace mode only: the parsed component/type/message the regex ran against.

LogPatternTestResult.doc: Aggregate outcome of one pattern test. Serialized camelCase to clients.

LogQueryRequest.doc: Body of POST global/raw/logs (operator log query).

fields.name: timespan
fields.doc: ISO-8601 duration; defaults to PT1H.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: One of !:LogQuerySources; defaults to backend.

fields.name: budgetSeconds
fields.doc: Wall-clock budget for the upstream call; clamped to 5..180, default 30.

MaintenanceResult.doc: Run report of a manual maintenance run (POST maintenance/trigger).

ManagedTenantItem.doc: One managed tenant as the managing tenant sees it.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: self-service (joined by invitation, removable here) | operator (provisioned by platform operators).

fields.name: usage
fields.doc: Absent when not resolved (cap reached or read failure).

ManagedTenantQuotaUsage.doc: MCP organization budget of a managed tenant, nested in ManagedTenantItem.

McpHealthCheckResponse.doc: Response of GET health/mcp: the standalone MCP-server reachability probe.

McpOrganizationUsageItem.doc: One account's share of the organization budget, nested in GetMcpOrganizationUsageResponse.

fields.name: userPrincipalName
fields.doc: Absent for rows written before the UPN was recorded.

fields.name: delegated
fields.doc: True when the account is a delegated (MSP) administrator homed in another tenant.

fields.name: homeTenantId
fields.doc: The delegated administrator's home tenant; absent for the tenant's own members.

fields.name: lastRequestAt
fields.doc: Absent for rows written before the timestamp was recorded.

McpQuotaExceededResponse.doc: 429 body written by McpQuotaEnforcementMiddleware when the per-user MCP daily/monthly quota is exhausted. Carries the error-envelope prefix (error, code=QuotaExceeded, correlationId); quotaExceeded is the discriminator the MCP error handler keys on.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: The full quota message (whose window, which plan, when it resets).

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: Which window was exceeded ("daily"/"monthly") — always set on the blocked path.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: Whose budget was exceeded: "user" (the caller's own plan) or "tenant" (the organization-wide windows).

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Limit of the exceeded window.

fields.name: used
fields.doc: Used count of the exceeded window.

fields.name: resetUtc
fields.doc: Reset time of the exceeded window, pre-formatted "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ".

fields.name: targetTenantId
fields.doc: The MANAGED tenant whose organization windows blocked a delegated (MSP) read — its plan governs the budget, not the caller's. Absent when the caller's own tenant/plan was exceeded and on the all-managed-tenants-exhausted aggregate block.

McpUsageQuotaNode.doc: Effective quota state nested in GetMyMcpUsageResponse: the caller's own windows and the organization-wide windows of their tenant (shared by every member; 0 = unlimited). For a delegated (MSP) caller the tenant windows are those of their HOME tenant — reads into managed tenants are charged to the managed tenant per request and never appear here.

MessageResponse.doc: Message-only acknowledgement: { "message": ... } — the 200 shape of the member, group, binding and MCP-user mutations (no success key: adding one would change the wire these sites have always written).

MetricsSummaryResponse.doc: Per-tenant session-status tally envelope shared by MetricsSummary and MetricsSummaryGlobal.

MetricsSummaryTenantItem.doc: One per-tenant status tally in MetricsSummaryResponse. WindowDays is repeated per item (envelope carries it too — historical wire shape, kept for parity).

fields.name: failureRate
fields.doc: Failed over the TERMINAL outcomes only (Succeeded + Failed), percent rounded to one decimal; 0 without terminal sessions.

NotificationListResponse.doc: Shared response of GET global/notifications and GET notifications: the active (non-dismissed) notifications visible to the caller, newest first.

NvdRefreshRunWire.doc: Outcome of the last NVD stale-cache refresh walk on THIS instance (in-memory).

fields.name: skippedThrottled
fields.doc: Stale entries left untouched because NVD opened its throttle cooldown mid-run.

fields.name: startedUtc
fields.doc: Preformatted ISO-8601 start timestamp.

fields.name: finishedUtc
fields.doc: Preformatted ISO-8601 finish timestamp, or null (key omitted) while still running.

OffboardResponse.doc: 202/200 response body for the offboarding endpoint. Fields point the caller at the History row so subsequent reporting / status polling can resolve back to the audit trail. EarliestProcessingAt drives the "data deletion starts in mm ss" countdown in the Web UI's drain-barrier state.

fields.name: earliestProcessingAt
fields.doc: UTC timestamp before which the worker MUST NOT start Phase 2. Drives the cache-drain-barrier countdown UI. Absent on the idempotent-Completed/Failed branches.

OpsEventListResponse.doc: Response of GET global/ops-events, paged and non-paged: the non-paged variant leaves NextLink null so the key is absent, exactly like the old literal.

fields.name: nextLink
fields.doc: Absolute-path link to the next page, or null on the last page / non-paged variant — the key is omitted when null.

PatchTenantConfigurationFieldsRequest.doc: Body of PATCH config/{tenantId}/fields: { "fields": { <fieldName>: <value>, ... }, "reason"?: "..." } with at least one field. Values take the field's own JSON type (TenantConfiguration).

PatchTenantPlanRequest.doc: Body of PATCH config/{tenantId}/plan. Presence matters: an absent key leaves the value unchanged, an explicit null clears the override (trial end, delegated-slot cap, MCP plan). The endpoint reads the keys by name from this type.

fields.name: planTier
fields.doc: community or pro.

fields.name: trialExpiresUtc
fields.doc: ISO-8601 UTC; null ends the trial.

fields.name: maxDelegatedTenants
fields.doc: Non-negative; null clears the per-tenant override.

fields.name: mcpUsagePlan
fields.doc: Usage-plan name; null clears the override.

PercentileStats.doc: Distribution of a per-session statistic across a version bucket.

fields.name: sampleCount
fields.doc: Number of sessions contributing to the duration distribution (after the >0 filter).

fields.name: clampedSessionCount
fields.doc: Number of sessions whose raw duration exceeded the clamp ceiling and were capped before aggregation. A non-zero value flags stuck/non-terminal sessions skewing the window — the percentiles above are computed on the clamped values, not the runaway wall-clock duration.

PlanTierDefinition.doc: Defines a usage plan tier with request limits: the per-USER windows every account on the plan gets, and the organization-wide TENANT windows all members of a tenant on this plan share. Stored as JSON array in AdminConfiguration.PlanTierDefinitionsJson. 0 = unlimited for that window.

fields.name: tenantDailyRequestLimit
fields.doc: Tenant-wide daily limit; null (not set) = the edition's catalog tenant limit, 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: tenantMonthlyRequestLimit
fields.doc: Tenant-wide monthly limit; null (not set) = the edition's catalog tenant limit, 0 = unlimited.

PlanTierDefinitionsResponse.doc: Response of GET and PUT global/config/plan-tiers: the global usage-plan tier definitions.

fields.name: sessionsScanned
fields.doc: Sessions the scan actually covered in the window (before the has-snapshots filter that shapes Sessions). Callers must compare THIS against SessionLimit to decide whether the window was truncated — Sessions.Count understates truncation on fleets where many sessions emit no agent_metrics_snapshot.

PlatformStats.doc: Pre-computed platform-wide statistics for the public landing page. Stored as a single row (PartitionKey: "global", RowKey: "current"). Incremented during registration/ingest/login; the daily maintenance recompute treats every cumulative counter as a monotonic "since release" high-water-mark (raise-only — the scanned tables are retention-pruned, so a raw recompute would regress the figures). Only TotalSignedUpTenants is current-state (its source table is not retention-pruned). See MaintenanceService.BuildMonotonicPlatformStats.

fields.name: totalEnrollments
fields.doc: Total enrollment sessions monitored since launch

fields.name: totalUsers
fields.doc: Total unique users who logged in

fields.name: totalTenants
fields.doc: Total unique tenants using the platform (have at least one session)

fields.name: totalSignedUpTenants
fields.doc: Total tenants signed up (have a tenant configuration entry)

fields.name: uniqueDeviceModels
fields.doc: Total unique device models seen (manufacturer + model)

fields.name: totalEventsProcessed
fields.doc: Total events processed across all tenants

fields.name: successfulEnrollments
fields.doc: Total successful enrollments

fields.name: issuesDetected
fields.doc: Total analysis issues detected

fields.name: lastFullCompute
fields.doc: When these stats were last fully recomputed

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.doc: When these stats were last updated (including incremental)

fields.doc: Session metrics

fields.name: tenants
fields.doc: Tenant metrics

fields.name: deploymentTypes

fields.doc: When these metrics were computed

fields.name: fromCache

fields.name: windowDays
fields.doc: Time window (in days) the metrics were computed over.

PreviewWhitelistActionResponse.doc: Acknowledgement of the preview-whitelist mutations (approve 201/200, revoke, save notification email, send welcome email): a message plus the echoed subject — each site sets only the keys its old anonymous body wrote (null keys vanish).

fields.name: alreadyApproved
fields.doc: Approve only: true when the tenant was already on the whitelist (idempotent success).

fields.name: welcomeEmailSent
fields.doc: Save-notification-email only: whether the once-only welcome mail went out with this save.

PreviewWhitelistTenantEntry.doc: One approved tenant on the wire. Deliberately NOT the storage entity: the pre-2026-08-31 wire carried synthetic PreviewWhitelistEntity rows whose only real datum was the tenant id in partitionKey (plus garbage defaults) — the contract is now just the id.

ProgressGetSessionEventsResponse.doc: Response of GET /api/progress/sessions/{sessionId}/events — the session's event stream after the serial knowledge proof passed.

ProgressLookupSessionResponse.doc: Response of GET /api/progress/sessions/lookup — resolves at most ONE session from the serial/device-name search term (Progress Portal knowledge-proof lookup).

fields.name: found
fields.doc: True when a session matched the search term.

fields.name: session
fields.doc: The matched session; null (key omitted on the wire) when nothing matched.

QueryBackendLogsErrorResponse.doc: Error body of POST /api/global/raw/logs when the telemetry store rejected or failed the query (400 for a caller-side KQL error, 502 for store/grant failures): the envelope prefix plus the store's own error code, HTTP status and — capped — its full response, so nothing the CLI would print is lost. hint tells the caller how to fix the query.

fields.name: upstreamCode
fields.doc: The store's error code (e.g. Kusto SyntaxError); absent when the store sent none.

fields.name: statusCode
fields.doc: The store's HTTP status.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Which telemetry store answered (query_backend_logs source).

fields.name: upstream
fields.doc: The store's response body, capped; absent when empty.

QueryBackendLogsResponse.doc: Success body of POST /api/global/raw/logs (QueryBackendLogs): the KQL result of one telemetry store in the Kusto REST shape (tables[].columns/rows), wrapped with the source it came from and the proxy's own observations. The table shape is kept verbatim so every consumer that parsed the raw App Insights body keeps working.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: The store the query ran against — one of LogQuerySources.All.

fields.name: timespan
fields.doc: ISO 8601 duration the query was bounded to (echo of the request, defaulted).

fields.name: budgetSeconds
fields.doc: Server-side budget the upstream call ran under (clamped request value).

fields.name: elapsedMs
fields.doc: Wall-clock time of the upstream call.

fields.name: partial
fields.doc: True when the store answered 200 but flagged the result as incomplete (Kusto PartialError: result-size cap, shard timeout). Absent on a complete result — never silent, because a truncated aggregate reads like a smaller number.

fields.name: partialReason
fields.doc: The store's own explanation when Partial is true.

QueryRawEventsResponse.doc: Success body of GET /api/raw/events and /api/global/raw/events (QueryRawEvents / QueryRawEventsGlobal): raw event rows, PascalCase-verbatim stored columns.

fields.name: tenantId
fields.doc: Null on the global scope when no tenantId filter was given (cross-tenant query).

fields.name: nextLink
fields.doc: Absent on the last page.

fields.name: partial
fields.doc: True when the server ended this page early because its scan budget was spent before pageSize index rows were walked. Nothing is lost: every event up to the cursor is on this page and NextLink resumes exactly after the last fully processed chunk. Absent on a page that filled or drained normally.

QueryRawSessionsResponse.doc: Success body of GET /api/raw/sessions and /api/global/raw/sessions (QueryRawSessions / QueryRawSessionsGlobal): raw SessionsIndex rows, PascalCase-verbatim stored columns.

fields.name: tenantId
fields.doc: Null on the global scope when no tenantId filter was given (cross-tenant query).

fields.name: nextLink
fields.doc: Absent on the last page.

QueryRawTableResponse.doc: Success body of GET /api/global/raw/tables/{tableName} (QueryRawTable): raw table rows, PascalCase-verbatim stored columns.

fields.name: nextLink
fields.doc: Absent on the last page.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: One of ServerActionTypes.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Optional operator note; defaults to "Manual action queued by {user}".

fields.name: params
fields.doc: Action-specific parameters, see Params.

fields.name: queuedAt
fields.doc: Server-stamped enqueue time (UTC).

QuickSearchResult.doc: Lightweight result for the global quick-search typeahead.

fields.name: matchedField
fields.doc: Which field matched the query: "sessionId", "serialNumber", or "deviceName".

RateLimitInfo.doc: Rate limit information for UI display

fields.name: requestsInWindow
fields.doc: Number of requests in current window

fields.name: maxRequests
fields.doc: Maximum allowed requests

fields.name: windowDurationSeconds
fields.doc: Window duration in seconds

fields.name: retryAfterSeconds
fields.doc: Seconds to wait before retrying

RebootSpan.doc: One observed reboot outage: the gap between the last pre-reboot event and the first post-reboot event, located via the lastBootUtc payload (audit Q7: the system_reboot_detected event itself is detection-time-stamped by the NEXT agent run and is never used as the reboot moment).

fields.name: segmentKey
fields.doc: Segment the reboot started in (TimeAttributionSegments key, or "unattributed" when it began in an unattributed hole).

ReclassificationResult.doc: Run report of the legacy-session reclassification job (POST maintenance/reclassify-legacy).

fields.name: capReached
fields.doc: True when the maxSessions cap stopped the run before the backlog was exhausted — re-run to continue.

ReclassifyJobRunResponse.doc: Response of POST maintenance/reclassify-legacy: the reclassification run report plus trigger attribution. See BackfillJobRunResponse for the shared key layout.

RegisterSessionRequest.doc: Request to register a new session

RegisterSessionResponse.doc: Response from session registration. Also the body of the 409/410 refusals — the agent reads ErrorCode from it, so the error envelope is NOT used on this route.

fields.name: adminAction
fields.doc: Non-null when the session was already marked as terminal by an admin before agent restart. Values: "Succeeded", "Failed". Agent should run cleanup instead of starting monitoring.

fields.name: validatedBy
fields.doc: Authoritative signal: which validator accepted this device. Lets the agent reconcile its registry-based enrollment-type detection against the backend's verdict (e.g. AutopilotV1 → Classic flow, DeviceAssociation → DevPrep flow). Older backends that do not set this return Unknown — agent falls back to its own detection.

fields.name: errorCode
fields.doc: Machine-readable reason on a failure response (see AgentErrorCodes). Null on success and on failures that carry no agent-actionable code.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Display title for the link

fields.name: url
fields.doc: URL to the documentation

ReleaseDelegatedSlotHoldResponse.doc: Response of POST global/delegated-slots/{tenantId}/release-hold: how many holds ended now.

RemediationStep.doc: A remediation step with title and sub-steps

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Title of the remediation approach

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Ordered steps to execute

ReseedFromGitHubResponse.doc: Response of POST rules/reseed-from-github: per-catalog reseed counters.

ReseedImeLogPatternsResponse.doc: Response of POST rules/ime-log-patterns/reseed (Global Admin only).

ReseedRuleCountsNode.doc: Reseed counters for a rule table with sunset handling (gather / analyze).

fields.name: orphanStatesGcd
fields.doc: Orphan per-tenant RuleState rows cleaned while sunsetting rules missing from the new catalog.

fields.name: sunsetSkipped
fields.doc: Sunset rules skipped on failure (retried on the next reseed).

ReseedTableCountsNode.doc: Reseed counters for a plain delete-and-rewrite table (IME patterns, CPE mappings).

RestoreRowCommitResponse.doc: Successful response body of mode=commit. Echoes the write outcome.

fields.name: outcome
fields.doc: Inserted when the live row was absent, Replaced when it existed.

RestoreRowMode.doc: Operating mode for POST /api/global/backups/{backupId}/restore-row. Preview is a read-only diff; Commit is the conditional write under maintenance lease + ETag-CAS.

RestoreRowPreviewResponse.doc: Response body of mode=preview. Contains the backup-row dump, the live row (or null), a per-property diff, the row-hash to echo on commit, and the live ETag (or null) to echo on commit.

fields.name: backupProperties
fields.doc: EDM-tagged property snapshot from the backup NDJSON line. Keys are case-faithful original Azure Table column names.

fields.name: currentProperties
fields.doc: EDM-tagged property snapshot of the live row, or null if the live row does not currently exist.

fields.name: rowSha256
fields.doc: SHA-256 (hex, lowercase) of the raw NDJSON line bytes. Echo this on Commit.

fields.name: currentETag
fields.doc: Live-row ETag at preview time, or null if the live row did not exist.

fields.name: isAuthTable
fields.doc: True for tables whose IsEnabled column carries security semantics (AuthTablesFullRestoreForbidden). UI must render the warning banner.

RestoreRowPropertyDiff.doc: Per-property diff entry — exactly one property name with a change kind.

RestoreRowPropertySnapshot.doc: Single EDM-tagged property value carried over the wire. Matches the shape of DeletionPropValue but is a separate DTO so we can serialize JsonElement snapshots from both backup and live rows without leaking a Deletion-namespaced type.

RestoreRowRequest.doc: Body of POST /api/global/backups/{backupId}/restore-row. PartitionKey + RowKey are carried in the body (never the URL) because Azure Tables permits /, +, % in PK/RK; URL-encoding them on the route would interact poorly with the Functions router.

fields.name: ifSha256
fields.doc: SHA-256 (hex, lowercase) of the raw NDJSON line bytes echoed from the matching Preview response. Required on Commit. The server re-computes the hash on the fresh NDJSON line and rejects with 409 on mismatch (tamper / blob churn after the preview).

fields.name: ifCurrentETag
fields.doc: Live-row ETag echoed from the matching Preview response. null means "Preview saw no live row" → Commit uses AddEntity. A non-null value means "Preview saw a live row with this ETag" → Commit uses UpdateEntity(ifMatch=etag, Replace). Mismatch (412) or existence change → 409 CurrentRowChanged.

fields.name: tenantId
fields.doc: Optional: when the Sessions row is already gone (full-restore case after a completed cascade), there is no SessionsIndex entry to look up the tenant from — provide it explicitly.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Optional free-text justification, persisted into the deletion_restored audit row's reason detail. Trimmed and capped at 1024 chars by the endpoint.

RuleCondition.doc: A condition that is evaluated against the event stream

fields.name: signal
fields.doc: Descriptive name for this signal (e.g., "proxy_407_error")

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Source of the signal: "event_type", "event_data", "event_data_array", "phase_duration", "event_count", "app_install_duration", "event_correlation", "clock_skew". Must stay in sync with DryRunAnalyzeRuleFunction.KnownSources and the RuleEngine switch.

fields.name: skewMetric
fields.doc: For "clock_skew" only: which device-clock metric to evaluate — "clock_jump" (persistent step in the device's clock frame mid-session) or "sustained_offset" (whole session ran on a clock off by ≥ Value). Value is the threshold in seconds; Operator is limited to gt/gte on the magnitude.

fields.name: eventType
fields.doc: Event type to match on. For "event_type"/"event_data": the event type to match. For "event_correlation": the FIRST event type (Event A).

fields.name: dataField
fields.doc: Data field to match on. For "event_data": field to check with Operator/Value. For "event_data_array": the ARRAY field to iterate (e.g. "artifacts"). For "event_correlation": optional filter field on Event B (the second event). Uses dot notation for nested fields (e.g., "data.errorCode").

fields.name: itemField
fields.doc: For "event_data_array" only: the sub-field on each array element to test with Operator/Value (e.g. "identity"). When empty, each element is treated as a scalar. The condition matches when ANY element satisfies the operator (e.g. one artifact whose identity does not match an allow-list regex).

fields.name: operator
fields.doc: Comparison operator: "equals", "not_equals", "contains", "not_contains", "regex", "not_regex", "gt", "lt", "gte", "lte", "exists", "not_exists", "count_gte", "count_per_group_gte", "in", "not_in". For "event_correlation": operator for the Event B filter (applied to DataField). Must stay in sync with DryRunAnalyzeRuleFunction.KnownOperators.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Value to compare against. For "event_correlation": value for the Event B filter.

fields.name: required
fields.doc: Whether this condition must match for the rule to fire If false, it only contributes to confidence scoring

fields.name: filterField
fields.doc: Optional same-event value filter: only events whose FilterField satisfies FilterOperator/FilterValue are considered by the condition. For "event_count": applies before counting (both count_gte and count_per_group_gte), e.g. count only performance_snapshot events with memory_used_percent > 90. For "event_data"/"event_data_array": the filter and the main DataField/Operator test are evaluated on the SAME event instance — the only way to pin two fields of one event together, since separate conditions each scan all events independently (e.g. system_sleep_episode with durationSeconds >= 300 AND backfilled = false).

fields.name: filterOperator
fields.doc: Operator for the same-event filter. Uses the same operators as the main Operator field.

fields.name: filterValue
fields.doc: Value for the same-event filter.

fields.name: correlateEventType
fields.doc: The second event type to correlate with (Event B). Example: "app_install_failed"

fields.name: joinField
fields.doc: The data field to join on — must have the same value in both Event A and Event B. Example: "appId" means both events must share the same appId value.

fields.name: timeWindowSeconds
fields.doc: Maximum time in seconds between Event A and Event B. Null or 0 means no time limit.

fields.name: suppressByEvent
fields.doc: Optional suppression: if an event of SuppressByEvent.EventType exists with the same SuppressByEvent.JoinField value as the matched event, the match is skipped (the "resolving" event suppresses the finding). Used to prevent rules from firing when a subsequent event resolved the issue.

fields.name: eventAFilterField
fields.doc: Optional filter field on Event A (the first event). Combined with EventAFilterOperator and EventAFilterValue.

fields.name: eventAFilterOperator
fields.doc: Operator for the Event A filter. Uses same operators as the main Operator field.

fields.name: eventAFilterValue
fields.doc: Value for the Event A filter.

RuleDryRun.doc: Full diagnostic trace of one dry-run evaluation. Serialized camelCase to clients.

fields.name: eventCount
fields.doc: Number of events in the session the rule was evaluated against.

fields.name: confidenceFactors
fields.doc: Empty unless all required conditions were met (mirrors the production path, which never reaches factor evaluation otherwise).

fields.name: finalConfidence
fields.doc: base + matched factor weights, capped at 100. Null when the evaluation ended before the confidence stage (precondition skip / required miss / nothing matched).

fields.name: wouldMarkSessionAsFailed
fields.doc: True only for verdict "fired" AND the rule's effective MarkSessionAsFailed flag. The dry-run itself never touches the session.

fields.name: matchedConditions
fields.doc: The evidence map exactly as the production path would persist it on a RuleResult — keys are condition signals (plus factor_* markers). Clients use it to preview {{token}} interpolation of explanation/remediation. Values are heterogeneous evidence objects by design.

fields.name: evidence
fields.doc: Matched: the evidence dictionary (eventId, timestamp, field, value, …). Not matched: the evaluator's reason string (e.g. "no matching events").

fields.name: matchingEventCount
fields.doc: How many session events have this condition's eventType at all — the first thing an author checks when a condition unexpectedly doesn't match. Null when the condition has no eventType.

RulePrecondition.doc: A device-fact gate evaluated before a rule's conditions. Pure boolean filter — does not contribute to evidence or confidence. When any precondition on a rule fails, the rule is silently skipped (no result emitted). Currently only event_data source is supported.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Source of the fact. Currently only event_data.

fields.name: eventType
fields.doc: Event type carrying the field to test (e.g., hardware_spec, os_info).

fields.name: dataField
fields.doc: Data field to test (dot notation supported for nested fields).

fields.name: operator
fields.doc: Comparison operator. Same vocabulary as Operator minus the count_/correlation-specific operators.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Value to compare against. Boolean values are stringified ("true"/"false").

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional human-readable note explaining the intent (e.g., "skip on virtual machines"). Not evaluated.

RuleRegressionAlert.doc: One ACTIVE rule-frequency regression (F3, insights spec §F3): an analyze rule whose 7-day hit rate rose ≥2× over its 28-day baseline with disjoint Wilson intervals. Persisted as the ruleregression|{ruleId} keyspace of the notification tracker table — the row IS the dedup (one bell per episode), the badge state (rules page) and the regressions[] payload (rule-stats response). Deleted when the rate re-arms (falls under 1.5× baseline or stops firing) or by the tracker's 30-day retention sweep (spec: retention cleanup re-arms). Numbers are refreshed on every radar pass while the episode stays active; FirstNotifiedAt never moves.

fields.name: lift
fields.doc: Window rate ÷ baseline rate. Null when the baseline rate is 0 (a NEW signal has no finite lift — never invented).

fields.name: windowStartDate
fields.doc: Trailing 7-day window ("yyyy-MM-dd", inclusive) the current numbers describe.

fields.name: dimension
fields.doc: Dimension concentration captured when the alert FIRST fired (stable story); null = no clear concentration.

fields.name: firstNotifiedAt
fields.doc: When the episode first fired (bell + ops event moment). Never moves on refresh; drives the 30d retention re-arm.

fields.name: lastEvaluatedAt
fields.doc: Last radar pass that re-confirmed/refreshed this episode.

RuleRegressionDimension.doc: The dominant dimension value among a regression's hit sessions — CORRELATION only, and every consumer's wording must say so ("correlated — not necessarily causal", insights spec §F3 / truthfulness rule 6). Null on an alert means "no clear dimension concentration" — the radar never stretches for one.

fields.name: dimension
fields.doc: "osBuild", "model", "agentVersion" or "imeVersion".

fields.name: hitCount
fields.doc: Hit sessions carrying this value (gate: ≥5).

fields.name: lift
fields.doc: HitShare ÷ AllShare (gate: ≥2.0).

RuleResult.doc: Result of an analyze rule evaluation against a session's events Stored in the RuleResults table and displayed in the session detail UI

fields.name: resultId
fields.doc: Unique identifier for this result

fields.name: sessionId
fields.doc: Session this result belongs to

fields.name: tenantId
fields.doc: Tenant this result belongs to

fields.name: ruleId
fields.doc: The rule that produced this result

fields.name: ruleTitle
fields.doc: Human-readable title of the rule

fields.name: severity
fields.doc: Severity level: "info", "warning", "high", "critical"

fields.name: category
fields.doc: Rule category: network, identity, enrollment, apps, esp, device

fields.name: confidenceScore
fields.doc: Confidence score (0-100) Higher = more confident this issue is the root cause

fields.name: explanation
fields.doc: Detailed explanation of the detected issue

fields.name: remediation
fields.doc: Remediation steps for the detected issue

fields.name: relatedDocs
fields.doc: Links to relevant documentation

fields.name: matchedConditions
fields.doc: Evidence: which conditions matched and their values

fields.name: detectedAt
fields.doc: When this issue was detected

fields.name: firstDetectedAt
fields.doc: When this finding FIRST fired for the session (stable across interim refreshes and the terminal finalization pass). Null on legacy rows — treat DetectedAt as the anchor.

fields.name: lastEvaluatedAt
fields.doc: When the rule was last (re-)evaluated for this session. Null on legacy rows.

fields.name: isInterim
fields.doc: True while the finding comes from an interim run (whiteglove_sealed / on_event trigger) and has not yet been confirmed by the terminal finalization pass. UI renders these with a "preliminary" badge.

fields.name: resolvedAt
fields.doc: Set when a later evaluation no longer fired the rule (the session healed). Resolved rows are kept for audit but excluded from issue counts and hidden by default.

fields.name: notifiedAt
fields.doc: Set once the finding's channel notification was sent. The notification dedupe anchors here (one notification per session+rule), decoupled from row existence so interim refreshes and the manual reanalyze rebuild can never re-arm a duplicate send.

RuleStatsPeriod.doc: Echo of the effective date window ("yyyy-MM-dd").

RuleStatsResponse.doc: Response of GET metrics/rule-stats and GET global/metrics/rule-stats: per-rule firing aggregates over the requested window, the active rule-frequency regression episodes (tenant scope only — empty on the cross-tenant aggregate), and window totals.

RuleStatsRuleAggregate.doc: One rule's aggregate across all dates in the window (fires descending).

fields.name: hitRate
fields.doc: Fires per evaluation as a percentage (one decimal); 0 with no evaluations.

fields.name: avgConfidenceScore
fields.doc: Average confidence score across fires (one decimal); 0 with no fires.

fields.name: trend
fields.doc: Per-day trend rows, oldest first (one row per stored date).

RuleStatsSummary.doc: Window totals of a rule-stats response.

fields.name: topRuleByFireCount
fields.doc: Rule id with the most fires; absent when the window holds no rules.

fields.name: uniqueRules
fields.doc: Distinct rule count — set on the global route only (the key is absent on the tenant route, preserving its historical shape).

RuleTrendPoint.doc: One day of a rule's trend ("yyyy-MM-dd").

SaveCustomCpeMappingRequest.doc: Body of POST vulnerability/cpe-mapping; normalizedProduct and cpeUri are required, the rest default server-side.

fields.name: normalizedVendor
fields.doc: Defaults to "unknown".

fields.name: category
fields.doc: Defaults to "custom".

SaveCustomCpeMappingResponse.doc: Response of POST vulnerability/cpe-mapping on a successful save.

fields.name: rowKey
fields.doc: Sanitized Table Storage row key the mapping was stored under.

SaveNotificationEmailRequest.doc: Body of PUT preview/notification-email and POST preview/send-welcome-email/{tenantId}.

ScriptDisplayNamesRequest.doc: Body of POST tenants/{tenantId}/scripts/display-names: Graph script references to resolve.

SearchSessionsResponse.doc: SearchSessions envelope. Sessions carries full SessionSummary items, or dictionary projections of them when the caller passed a fields= subset.

fields.name: nextLink
fields.doc: Absent when there is no further page.

ServerAction.doc: Server-issued action that the agent should execute. Delivered piggy-backed on ingest responses — no extra polling required. Actions are queued on the session row (Sessions.PendingActionsJson) by server-side writers (admin endpoints, rule engine, maintenance) and picked up on the agent's next ingest call. Delivery is best-effort at-least-once: the agent must be idempotent for its intended operation.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Action type — one of ServerActionTypes. Unknown types are logged and skipped by the agent so rolling out a new type doesn't require a synchronous agent update.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Human-readable reason for this action. Surfaced in logs and agent telemetry. Do not include secrets — values flow through Application Insights.

fields.name: ruleId
fields.doc: Optional rule that triggered this action. Set when queued from the RuleEngine, null for admin/manual triggers.

fields.name: params
fields.doc: Free-form string parameters for the action. Each action type defines its own keys. Using string values (not nested objects) keeps the on-wire shape flat and predictable and sidesteps JSON deserialization quirks in the net48 agent. Conventions: terminate_session: gracePeriodSeconds — (optional) seconds the agent keeps collecting before shutdown; default 30 uploadDiagnostics — (optional) "true"/"false"; attempt a best-effort diagnostics upload pre-shutdown rotate_config: (no parameters) request_diagnostics: (no parameters)

fields.name: queuedAt
fields.doc: When this action was queued. Used for TTL / staleness detection and telemetry.

SessionAnnotationItem.doc: Wire shape of one session annotation as returned by the session-scoped annotation endpoints (lane implied by context, tenant/session implied by the route). Built by AnnotationWire.ToWire.

fields.name: verdict
fields.doc: One of the annotation verdict vocabulary values, or null (note-only annotation) — the key is omitted when null.

fields.name: note
fields.doc: Free-text note, or null (verdict-only annotation) — the key is omitted when null.

fields.name: ruleIds
fields.doc: Snapshot of the rule ids that had fired for the session at write time.

SessionAnnotationListResponse.doc: Shared response of the annotation list endpoints (global/session-annotations and sessions/annotations/list): one page of scoped annotations with an optional continuation link.

fields.name: nextLink
fields.doc: Absolute-path link to the next page, or null on the last page — the key is omitted when null.

SessionAnnotationScopedItem.doc: Wire shape of one session annotation in the cross-session list endpoints, where each row carries its own tenant/session scope. Built by AnnotationWire.ToWireWithScope.

fields.name: verdict
fields.doc: One of the annotation verdict vocabulary values, or null (note-only annotation) — the key is omitted when null.

fields.name: note
fields.doc: Free-text note, or null (verdict-only annotation) — the key is omitted when null.

fields.name: ruleIds
fields.doc: Snapshot of the rule ids that had fired for the session at write time.

SessionDeletionListItem.doc: One session row in a cascade-deletion state (GetSessionDeletionsList).

fields.name: timestamp
fields.doc: Row timestamp, pre-formatted round-trip ("o").

SessionDeletionProgressWire.doc: Worker progress projection nested in GetSessionDeletionManifestResponse.

fields.name: lastObservedResidualCount
fields.doc: The verifier's OBSERVED residual count, capped at the sample size (lower bound at the cap).

SessionDeletionQueuedResponse.doc: Success body (202 Accepted) of the V2 cascade-delete enqueue; the rejected arms are SessionDeletionRejectedResponse.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Always "queued".

SessionDeletionRejectedResponse.doc: Error body of DELETE sessions/{id} when the cascade could not be enqueued (409 lock states, 503 kill-switch / CAS exhaustion, 404). Error-envelope prefix plus the lock diagnostics the portal renders; manifestId is absent when no manifest exists (kill-switch refusal).

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Constants.ApiErrorCodes: CascadeAlreadyInFlight, CascadePoisonedUseRestore, KillSwitchActive, CasExhaustedRetryLater, NotFound, InternalError.

fields.name: deletionState
fields.doc: The in-flight cascade's state on the 409 arms; absent otherwise.

fields.name: manifestId
fields.doc: The in-flight cascade's manifest on the 409 arms; absent otherwise.

SessionListResponse.doc: Paged session listing envelope shared by GetSessions, GetAllSessions, SearchSessionsByCve and SearchSessionsByEvent (identical wire shape).

fields.name: nextLink
fields.doc: Absent when there is no further page.

fields.name: quotaExcludedTenants
fields.doc: Managed tenants dropped from a delegated (MSP) MCP fleet aggregate because their organization MCP budget is exhausted (each managed tenant's own plan governs it). Absent unless at least one tenant was excluded; only GetAllSessions ever sets it.

fields.name: totalAllTime
fields.doc: Cumulative enrollment sessions since the tenant signed up (retention-independent per-tenant counter, see TenantStats). Null on the platform-wide (all-tenants) metrics, which carry the cumulative figure in PlatformStats instead.

fields.name: incomplete
fields.doc: Terminal, non-failure sessions (timeout reclassification): the sweep classified them as Incomplete instead of Failed. Surfaced as its own count and deliberately excluded from SuccessRate (denominator = Succeeded + Failed only), mirroring SessionStats and FleetHealthStats. See tasks/enrollment-status-reclassification.md §5.

fields.name: osLanguage

fields.doc: Whether this is pre-provisioned

fields.name: agentVersion
